newsitem.title: CHINA: Zhenhua Port to list 100 mln B shares on Aug 5.
newsitem.headline: Zhenhua Port to list 100 mln B shares on Aug 5.

text.p: Shanghai Zhenhua Port Machinery Co Ltd will list 100 million B shares on August 5 on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, a company statement said on Friday.

Zhenhua issued the B shares for foreign investors at $0.433 each in mid-July, raising net proceeds of $41.135 million to be used in its core business of making port cargo handling equipment, the company has said.
After the issue, the company had a total of 335 million shares outstanding, with B shares accounting for 29.85 percent and legal person shares 70.15 percent.
Legal person shares are normally considered to be state institutional shares but some 89.04 million of these shares were held by foreign institutions.
The company has forecast its 1997 net profits at 117.239 million yuan against 77.876 million yuan in 1996 based on international accounting standards.
